fact: The JICA study describes the Politique Nationale des TIC pour le Developpement, formulated in 2004 by the MPTDN with UNDP support, as the Malagasy government's main ICT policy; it gives no adoption act.
system: Politique nationale des TIC pour le développement 2004

fact: The policy sets seven strategic objectives with dated targets, including a digital network covering every fivondronana by 2015 and 10 million ICT users and 30,000 ICT engineers within ten years; the document states no cost.
system: Politique nationale des TIC pour le développement 2004

fact: The JICA study assesses progress against the policy's objectives: legal and regulatory reform (objective 6) is relatively advanced, while network extension (1) and ICT engineer training (4) are behind for lack of funds.
